title: The Circadian Rhythm of Urine Output in Healthy Infants
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to describe the 24-hour urine output including the urinary excretion of hormones, electrolytes and other osmotically active substances in healthy children age 0 to 3 years old.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy children, free of medication

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of urinary diseases
